verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs state it can 'automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks', which is a first-party inbound-mail capability. Its webhook docs show reliable delivery with retries and URL verification. The inbound evidence is a single summary line, with no detail on MX setup or the parsed payload. Missing for 10: documentation of pointing MX records at MailerSend, the parsed payload structure (headers, body, attachments), an API to retrieve inbound messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: Automatically parse and route incoming emails using rules and webhooks.
If your endpoint is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response, MailerSend automatically retries with exponential backoff for up to about 3 days.
